title: Vietnam Electronics PCBA Quality
thesis: Snowflake turns daily line data from a synthetic network of PCBA lines in northern Vietnam (solder paste printing to functional test) into first-pass yield and defect KPIs, 7-day quality-hold risk scores, critical-to-quality deviation anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: First-pass yield, quality holds, defects per 1,000 boards and boards started for 24 PCBA lines across 5 northern Vietnamese provinces.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to line-day rows.
The root-cause chart shows which hold causes fail the most boards first pass, from solder paste deviations to ICT fixture faults.
show: Boards failing first pass by root cause
tabs.call_out: One governed set of PCBA quality KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which lines are likely to have the next hold?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each PCBA line's probability of a quality hold in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags critical-to-quality deviation outliers per line, and the forecast projects network-wide first-pass yield for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How healthy are the lines behind those risks?

talking_points: Line availability and critical fixture and tooling spares coverage (stencils, nozzles, ICT probes) frame the response capacity.
PM compliance against first-pass yield by line shows where discipline and yield move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, hold, cause and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a line alarms right now?

talking_points: Live test-station readings land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the line's current risk band, then emails the shift quality engineer.
tabs.call_out: From alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for yield and defect metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic quality-hold SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
